artboards.title: Today — what it looks like now

annotations.text:
What makes it read as 2010:

1. Emoji as icons (🛒 🎒 ⚔️ 🏆 🏅)
2. Saturated yellow slab buttons, 900 weight
3. ALL CAPS everywhere, no hierarchy
4. No typeface — system font throughout
5. Hard borders, flat panels, no depth

DIRECTION A — Deep Table

A premium tabletop. Depth and glow, glass panels, one restrained gold accent kept for the single primary action. Gabarito + Manrope.

Tradeoff: quieter. Less immediately "fun" in a store screenshot, and the dark ground makes the six colours work harder.

DIRECTION B — Paper & Ink

Bright, tactile, colour-blocked. Ink outlines and hard drop shadows — physical, like pieces on a table. Fredoka + Nunito.

Tradeoff: reads younger. Closer to a children's app, which cuts against "a grandparent should play this too".

The three screens below are Direction A carried through, so you can judge it on more than a home screen.

The board itself is a rough stand-in — the real one is 3D and rendered live. Everything AROUND it is the actual proposal.
